host_functions.name: test_emit_bound
host_functions.contract: Checked module adapter slot, UTF-8 memory offset and length. The host counts every invocation and retains a bounded adapter/effect request trace. At trace exhaustion the attempted request is denied before protected work and the receipt explicitly reports incomplete trace and unrecorded effect count. Denial returns nonzero. No re-entry.

host_functions.name: test_clock_bound
host_functions.contract: Checked module adapter slot and finite core-precomputed scripted dispatch. No real clock, ambient fallback or re-entry. Every invocation records its test.clock effect, adapter identity/version and explicit allow, deny, script-exhausted or unexpected-operation result. A nonzero status prevents the i64 result entering the guest stack.

nominal_cells: Kinds 12/13 retain structural Sum when w=0. In this opt-in profile kind12/w=1 is an opaque wrapper and kind12/13/w=2 is a two-arm variant. a=boxed payload; x/y=low/high u32 of resolved module identity; z=declaration ordinal. Checked emitted operations validate marker, tag and identity before elimination.
nominal_recipe_witness: Atoms 26..30 retain module u64 in payload and declaration ordinal in n; atoms 31/32 retain adapter slot in payload. All retain ordered input/output signatures in y/z and effect bitmask in w.
